The ENFORCED defaults (permissions.defaultMode=acceptEdits, which auto-accepts edits while other tools still prompt and shift+tab toggles, and includeCoAuthoredBy=false) do NOT belong here, because Claude rewrites this user file in place on theme/tui changes and drops keys, and para symlinks it onto the SHARED para-home volume, so anything seeded here gets clobbered for every workspace.
